description.narrative: Från beredning "There are Fund objectives at three levels: outcome, bridging, and output. The intended outcome of the E5P Fund is described in the Rules of the Fund. There are two outcome objectives 1) significant energy savings; 2) a reduction of carbon dioxide (CO2) and other greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. There are no baseline or target values set at the outcome level. The output objectives for the Fund is actual projects being implemented in accordance to the requirements of the Fund as described in the Annex 2 of the Rules of the Fund. The actual projects will have to describe clear outputs related to the two main outcomes of the Fund in the form of estimated energy and environmental benefits. Reform results ("soft issues") are also measured within the framework of each project. There are bridging objectives for the intervention logic between the actual projects and the intended outcome of the Fund. These are the actual Fund Management activities, described in the Rules of the Fund and also in the Work Program for the Fund. Among these are 1) handling administrative issues, such as to prepare contribution agreements and to administer funding agreements; 2) establishing, maintaining and developing an E5Prelated policy dialogue with the counterparts in cooperation with the IFIs, and 3) paying attention to marketing, awareness and visibility to increase the awareness and competence regarding energy efficiency in the municipal utility sector in general, and E5P as a tool to solve bottlenecks in the sector in particular."

E5P syftar till att minska koldioxidutsläpp, öka energieffektivisering och minska miljöpåverkan från t ex avfall, vatten och avloppsvatten. Insatsen avser bidrag till E5P (Eastern Europe Energy Efficiency and Environment Partnership)att förutom Ukraina (pågående) inkludera även Moldavien, Georgien och Armenien.

The E5P´s objectives are to improve energy efficiency, reduce CO2 and Green House Gas Emissions and reduce impact on environment from i.a. waste, wastewater. The contribution concerns the extention of the E5P (Eastern Europe Energy Efficiency and Environment Partnershipto)to include beside Ukraine (on-going) also Moldova, Georgia och Armenia.

description.narrative:
During 2025 the following projects were completed:
- Armenia: Kotayk and Gegharkunik Solid Waste (EBRD)
- Moldova: Balti Trolleybuses (EBRD)
- Ukraine: Solar Power Plant for Water and Wastewater Utility in Chortkiv (Nefco)
- Ukraine: Ivano-Frankivsk Energy Efficiency in Public Buildings (Nefco)
They were presented with completion reports during the Assembly.
The following results were particularly interesting from the completion reports that were presented:
In 2025, a project was completed in which Nefco implemented energy efficiency improvements in 15 schools and 21 kindergartens in the city of Ivano-Frankivsk in Ukraine, which has resulted in a better school environment for over 19,000 children. The investment has contributed to a reduction in energy use by 43% while energy costs have been reduced by 48%. Municipal residents, children, parents and school staff have learned more about energy efficiency and at the same time been able to keep schools warm despite long power outages. The projects have been ongoing for a long time and have also contributed to the municipality improving its capacity to carry out international procurements.
In 2025, a project in the city of Chortkiv in western Ukraine, also completed by Nefco with the help of the E5P fund, which provides investment grants. Three solar panel plants with a capacity of 340 KW were built at three different water and wastewater treatment plants in the city. The plant is allowed to export electricity to the grid to contribute to the production of electricity while saving the city money. The city began work as early as 2023 and Nefco initiated studies together with Sida and the consulting company AFRY, which resulted in these completed investments. Since Russia's full-scale invasion, electricity prices have increased by 65%, which has been very noticeable in a municipality like Chortkiv where the electricity costs for water production make up 25% of the total costs. This, combined with an influx of more than 2600 internally displaced people, increases the pressure on the municipality and often the electricity shortage means that the facilities cannot produce clean water.
The project now contributes to a reduction of 281t of CO2 per year, reduced electricity use annually by 22% and not least to be an important demonstration project for other municipalities that want greater energy independence and strengthened resilience. The mayor of Chortkiv has been an active advocate of this type of solution. He presented in person the project and all the work at E5P's annual meeting in London on November 28, 2025.
It is always very valuable to visit the projects, which is usually possible during the steering group meetings in country.
In addition the following visibility events happened:
- 2 April 2025, Finland Event on Rebuilding Ukraines infrastructure organised by Nefco with signing of E5P grant agreement for Kremenchuk biofuel boiler project. https://www.nefco.int/news/nefco-continues-its-reconstruction-efforts-in-municipalities-across-ukraine-with-several-new-projects/ - 17 June 2025, Moldova inauguration events of two energy-efficient modernised healthcare institutions: maternity building of the Nisporeni District Hospital and the Polyclinic of the City of Telenesti, both implemented by Nefco with E5P grant co-financing. https://www.nefco.int/news/healthcare-institutions-in-nisporeni-and-telenesti-have-undergone-energy-efficiency-modernisations-in-moldova/ - 8 July 2025, Armenia inauguration of the EBRD project for solid waste management in Kotayk and Gegharkunik provinces co-financed by E5P grant funds. https://en.armradio.am/2025/07/08/armenia-inaugurates-e14-8m-waste-management-project-in-two-provinces/ - 23 September 2025, Ukraine inauguration of Nefcos completed project in Chortkiv, Ukraine for critical water and wastewater infrastructure. The E5P grant financed photovoltaic solar panels. https://www.nefco.int/news/ukraines-first-completed-solar-powered-critical-infrastructure-project/
The visibility events are usually appreciated by the embassies and it is therefore good to ensure that the embassies are informed and invited if not invited by the secretariat.
